records.issue_text: app/models/embeddable_host.rb:2 limits top-level domains to five letters, rejecting valid domains such as example.museum and preventing administrators from adding or editing them.
records.rationale: The diff shows in app/models/embeddable_host.rb line 2 a regex validation: `/\A[a-z0-9]+([\-\.]{1}[a-z0-9]+)*\.[a-z]{2,5}(:[0-9]{1,5})?(\/.*)?\Z/i`. The `[a-z]{2,5}` part limits TLDs to 2-5 characters, which would reject valid TLDs like .museum (6 chars), .technology (10 chars), and many other newer TLDs. This is a real bug that prevents administrators from adding hosts with longer TLDs.

records.issue_text: app/models/embeddable_host.rb:15–18 allows saved hosts containing ports, but lookup uses uri.host without the port, so entries such as example.com:8080 never match requests.
records.rationale: The finding identifies a real bug. In embeddable_host.rb, the validation regex on line 2 allows hosts with ports (:[0-9]{1,5}), and the before_validation only strips the protocol and path, not the port.
